value.rationale: The global strict monotonicity gives a motivated physical control law: at fixed mean chirality, faster stochastic reversals increase signed orbital circulation in every harmonic anisotropy, rather than inevitably canceling rotation. Its sharp slow/fast-switching bounds and exact covariance-zero classification resolve a natural relationship among chirality bias, trap geometry and measurable transport. This is a full structural parameter classification, not a routine restatement of a single already calculated moment.
